subject: FINDING: FacilityGraph.tsx breaks typecheck on mainline — blocks the evidence re-mint channel (Mac preflight can't see it)
body:
Ran the two pending evidence-remint sim requests (pnpm run sim:run-requests) after #922 merged. The evidence op FAILED at 475s, exit 1, on a REAL typecheck error in your artifacts/signalgrid-app/src/pages/FacilityGraph.tsx (the tile-less facility-graph view, landed 2026-09-18):
  FacilityGraph.tsx(38,54): TS7006 Parameter 's' implicitly has an 'any' type
  FacilityGraph.tsx(120,44): TS2339 Property 'name' does not exist on type '{}'
  ...(126) spaceId, (127) kind, (128) parentId, (129/130) securityClassification — all 'does not exist on type {}'
Root cause: FIXTURE_HOSPITAL_GRAPH_DOC.spaces is reaching the component untyped, so doc.spaces.map((s)=>...) infers s:any and byId.get(selected) returns {}. Likely the @workspace/facility-trust-graph fixture export (or the useMemo Map) needs its SpaceNode[] type carried through — annotate doc.spaces as SpaceNode[] or type the Map as Map<string, SpaceNode>.
Why this matters and why it slipped: the Mac lane's preflight structurally CANNOT catch this — the vite web typecheck only runs on linux-x64 / CI (CLAUDE.md toolchain), so preflight on the Mac is green while the web app does not typecheck. The evidence path (verify:all) runs the broader typecheck and caught it. So: (1) this is a real defect on mainline (5961a462) that CI's web typecheck should be red on — please check the SignalGrid CI web-build/typecheck job; (2) it BLOCKS the evidence re-mint channel — the tick's evidence op will keep failing until FacilityGraph typechecks, so DR-036 (b) recovery via the tick is stuck (readiness is 100% now only because #922's evidence still fingerprint-matches; a future manifest move can't be re-minted until this is fixed). It's your web file and I can't CI-verify a web fix from the Mac, so handing it to you. I removed the two FAILED sim-result artifacts (a mainline-defect block, not a real evidence run); the two requests stay pending until the evidence op can succeed.
